skill.displayName: 前三页市场格局分析专家

llm.summary: The skill mainly performs Amazon SERP analysis, but it also includes account/payment workflows, public upload capability, endpoint-overridable credentialed requests, and skill self-extension instructions that deserve review before installation.

dimensions.detail: Credentialed requests use environment-provided API keys and environment-overridable gateway/login endpoints without host allowlisting in the inspected scripts, and helper utilities can fetch arbitrary HTTP(S) media URLs or upload selected local files to public OSS URLs.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No hidden installer or automatic startup behavior was found; the package is a skill bundle with executable helper scripts invoked by the agent. Some helper paths reference shared code that is not present in the inspected artifact, which is an operational concern rather than evidence of abuse.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The main workflow is mostly scoped and user-confirmed for paid SERP/Keepa calls, but the artifact also instructs automatic feedback reporting, downstream chaining from the text-generation helper, and use of an expert-skill-creator when users ask to add capabilities.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The scripts persist API responses, reports, media, caches, session metadata, and upload URLs under linkfox directories with fallbacks to home or temp paths; onboarding also advises storing API keys in shell profile files. These behaviors are disclosed but broad for an analytics skill.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The SERP, Keepa enrichment, AIGC image understanding, and report generation flow is coherent for market analysis, but bundled phone/SMS login, API-key issuance, paid-order creation, public file upload, and skill self-extension go beyond the core analyst purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you trust LinkFox as the API, billing, and file-hosting provider. Keep gateway/login environment variables pointed at official LinkFox hosts, avoid uploading private reports unless a public URL is intended, review any phone/SMS or payment prompts carefully, and do not allow the self-extension workflow to add new skills without a separate review.
llm.findings:
[TT3] unexpected: Network use is expected for LinkFox APIs, but the artifact-backed concern is valid for sensitive flows: onboarding and gateway code can send Authorization headers, phone/SMS login data, token-generation traffic, and order actions to endpoints derived from environment variables without an allowlist.
[TT3] expected: SERP, Keepa, text-generation, and upload network calls are part of the stated workflow; the risk is under-scoped endpoint configurability and broad URL fetching, not network access by itself.
[LP3] unexpected: The skill documentation discloses many operations, but there is no separate permission declaration for network, local persistence, public upload, account handling, or payment-related helper authority.
[TP4] unexpected: The main market-analysis purpose is coherent, but the package also contains generic AIGC, feedback, account onboarding, API-key generation, and payment-order workflows that are broader than a user would expect from a SERP analyst skill.
[SDI-1] unexpected: The self-extension instruction to invoke expert-skill-creator and the account/payment onboarding materials materially expand trust boundaries beyond the reviewed SERP analysis behavior.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Automatic cross-skill orchestration is partly justified for report generation and image understanding, but downstream generation chaining, feedback submission, and payment/order helpers are not necessary for the core analysis task.
[SDI-4] unexpected: The artifact contains scope inconsistencies: helper docs discuss downstream generation while saying generation is out of scope, and storage docs say to avoid temp paths while implementations can fall back to home or temp directories.
